_comment: Runes added after undecember.thein.ru stopped updating (S8 Starwalker onwards). Hand-transcribed from the official LINE Games update notes (ud.floor.line.games). Runes whose numbers were never published (only described) are flagged unofficial=true and carry an empty level table; tags for those are inferred from the description.

runes.name: Frost Storm
runes.description: Fires an arrow that explodes to create a Chilling Area. The Chilling Area deals DMG for a set amount of time. Cannot use Parallel Shot, Cannot Split, Cannot Chain
level1: Area of Effect of Chilling Area 150
8% DMG Dampening when hitting the same target repeatedly
level45: Area of Effect of Chilling Area 150
8% DMG Dampening when hitting the same target repeatedly

Origin: Change to Chilling Area Explosion Frequency 0.1 s

runes.name: Axe Throw
runes.description: Throws a Fire Element axe to deal damage to enemies. The thrown axe varies depending on the equipped weapon type (1-handed: 3 piercing axes; Dual Wield: 1 axe fired twice that pierces all; 2-handed: 1 axe that explodes on hit). Cannot use Parallel Shot, Cannot Split, Cannot Chain
level1: 20% chance to inflict Rupture for 5 s on hit (Max Stacks: 5)
Amplifies Axe Throw DMG dealt to the target by 2% per 1 Rupture stack on hit
1-handed: Fire DMG +40, Fire DMG 300%, Projectile Count 3 (Max 7), Pierce Count 1, 10% DMG Dampening when hitting the same target repeatedly
Dual Wielding: Fire DMG +38, Fire DMG 280%, Projectile Count fixed to 1 and fires twice, Pierces All
2-handed: Fire DMG +50, Fire DMG 400%, Projectile Count fixed to 1 and explodes on hit, Explosion Range 200
level45: 20% chance to inflict Rupture for 5 s on hit (Max Stacks: 5)
Amplifies Axe Throw DMG dealt to the target by 2% per 1 Rupture stack on hit
1-handed: Fire DMG +959, Fire DMG 768%, Projectile Count 3 (Max 7), Pierce Count 1, 10% DMG Dampening when hitting the same target repeatedly
Dual Wielding: Fire DMG +947, Fire DMG 761%, Projectile Count fixed to 1 and fires twice, Pierces All
2-handed: Fire DMG +1375, Fire DMG 1326%, Projectile Count fixed to 1 and explodes on hit, Explosion Range 200

Source: Pierce Count +[1-2] when 1-handed weapon is equipped
Area of Effect +[40-80]% when 2-handed weapon is equipped
Verity: 100% chance to gain Hellfire effect for 5 s on hit
( Fire Penetration +10%, Increases Fire DMG by 10% )

runes.name: Charged Shot
runes.description: Charges energy at regular intervals and shoots a round to deal large DMG to a faraway enemy. Additional effects are granted based on charge stage. Cannot Multishot, Cannot Split, Cannot Chain
level1: 2% Projectile Max Move Distance per Stage
level45: 8% Projectile Max Move Distance per Stage

runes.name: Divine Punishment
runes.description: Focuses energy to create a field of lightning, striking all hostile targets within it with Divine Punishment. Upon landing a critical hit, there is a chance for an additional enhanced Divine Punishment to trigger. Cannot Multishot, Cannot use Parallel Shot, Cannot Pierce, Cannot Split, Cannot Chain
level1: Triggers Divine Punishment on enemies within the Lightning Field
Upon a critical hit, 40% chance for an additional Enhanced Divine Punishment to trigger
Enhanced Divine Punishment: +25% Strike DMG Multiplier, +8% Maximization Chance
level45: Triggers Divine Punishment on enemies within the Lightning Field
Upon a critical hit, 40% chance for an additional Enhanced Divine Punishment to trigger
Enhanced Divine Punishment: +25% Strike DMG Multiplier, +8% Maximization Chance

Source: Does not generate Enhanced Divine Punishment

runes.name: Wrathful Blow
runes.description: Physical-element ranged Spell that releases a fist-shaped burst of wrathful energy forward when cast. (Numbers were not published in the update notes; tags inferred from the description.)
runes.source: Sep 4 2025 update (S9 Abyss Gate) / Director's Letter vol.18

runes.name: Toxic Mist
runes.description: Poison-element Spell that causes a toxic explosion on the target, generating multiple projectiles from the target's location. Also referred to as "Poison Mist" in runestone options. (Numbers were not published in the update notes; tags inferred from the description.)
runes.source: Sep 4 2025 update (S9 Abyss Gate) / Director's Letter vol.18

runes.name: Lightning Slash
runes.description: Slashes with lightning that chains damage between nearby enemies. Synergises with the Iai-jutsu link rune. (Numbers were not published in the update notes; tags inferred from the description.)

runes.name: Flash
runes.description: Dashes forward delivering rapid strikes to every enemy along the charging path. Synergises with the Iai-jutsu link rune. (Numbers were not published in the update notes; tags inferred from the description.)

runes.name: Iai-jutsu
linkRules: Can be linked with Skills that satisfy Attack, Melee, Strike (must include all)
Cannot be linked with Skills that satisfy Totem, Sentry, Minion, Toggle

runes.name: Chain of Pain
linkRules: Can be linked with Skills that satisfy any one of Strike, DoT
Applies to Minions when linked to Summon Skill
level1: DMG increases per status effect afflicting the target (values not published)

runes.name: Transcendent Mana Storm
runes.description: Transcendent (unique) version of Mana Storm dropped by the hidden boss Starlight Guardian in the Wheel of Fate. Rune cannot be awakened.
linkRules: Can be linked with Skills that satisfy any one of Strike, DoT
Applies to Minions when linked to Summon Skill
level1: Strike DMG Amplification / DoT Amplification (values not published)

runes.name: Transcendent Harmony
runes.description: Transcendent (unique) link rune. Levels 1–10. Rune cannot be awakened.
linkRules: Can be linked with Skills that satisfy any one of Attack, Spell
Cannot be linked with Skills that satisfy Totem, Minion, Sentry, Toggle, Shout, Attack Enhance, Defense Enhance, Movement, Trap
level1: When HP and Mana are 50% or more: 10% Resource Cost Amplification, 25.5% DMG Amplification, +12% Attack Speed, +12% Cast Speed
When HP and Mana are under 50%: 20% Resource Cost Dampening, 25.5% DMG Amplification, +24% Attack Speed, +24% Cast Speed
(Unique Effect) 5% DMG Amplification when percentage of HP is higher than or equal to Mana
(Unique Effect) +1% HP Absorb on hit when percentage of HP is lower than Mana
(Unique Effect) +1% Barrier Absorb on hit when percentage of Barrier is lower than Mana
level45: When HP and Mana are 50% or more: 10% Resource Cost Amplification, 78.9% DMG Amplification, +14.9% Attack Speed, +14.9% Cast Speed
When HP and Mana are under 50%: 20% Resource Cost Dampening, 39.4% DMG Amplification, +29.9% Attack Speed, +29.9% Cast Speed
(Unique Effect) 5% DMG Amplification when percentage of HP is higher than or equal to Mana
(Unique Effect) +1% HP Absorb on hit when percentage of HP is lower than Mana
(Unique Effect) +1% Barrier Absorb on hit when percentage of Barrier is lower than Mana

runes.name: Transcendent Enhance Effect
runes.description: Transcendent (unique) link rune. Levels 1–10. Rune cannot be awakened.
linkRules: Can be linked with Skills that satisfy any one of Shout, Attack Enhance, Defense Enhance, Rapid Seal
level1: (Unique Effect) +15% Skill Rune Cooldown Recovery Speed
level45: (Unique Effect) +15% Skill Rune Cooldown Recovery Speed

runes.name: Transcendent Improved Technique
runes.description: Transcendent (unique) link rune. Levels 1–10. Rune cannot be awakened.
linkRules: Can be linked with Skills that satisfy any one of Attack, Spell
level1: (Unique Effect) 3% Minion DMG Amplification per 50 Intelligence (Max: 36%)
(Unique Effect) 3% Sentry DMG Amplification per 50 Dexterity (Max: 36%)
(Unique Effect) 3% DMG Amplification for every 50 Strength (Max: 36%)
level45: (Unique Effect) 3% Minion DMG Amplification per 50 Intelligence (Max: 36%)
(Unique Effect) 3% Sentry DMG Amplification per 50 Dexterity (Max: 36%)
(Unique Effect) 3% DMG Amplification for every 50 Strength (Max: 36%)

runes.name: Spell Activation upon Transcendent Spell Hit
runes.description: Must link an Activation (Spell, Strike) Skill and a Target (Spell) Skill in the arrow's direction. Target Skill must be registered in a Skill slot to activate. Transcendent (unique) trigger rune; numbers not published. Rune cannot be awakening
linkRules: Target Skill cannot be linked if any of the Attack, Channeling, Totem, Sentry, Minion, Movement, Toggle, Trap tags exist.
level1: DMG / Resource Cost Dampening for Activated Skill (values not published)

tagPatches._comment: Sep 4 2025 update: link runes with the [Melee] tag gained the [Spell] tag so they can also be linked to spell skills. Rules are relaxed accordingly (Melee + Strike + (Attack or Spell)).
